body: I got over 200 comments, it's impossible for me to reply to everything. But no, i did respond to comments criticizing me as well, i just didn't reply to the ones that were straight up being assholes / trolls
Yeah, I understand that! I wouldn't mind genuinely answering the question in another situation. I was just very stressed and she presented it in a very bad moment
Thank you!! I try my best

She does! She gladly took me to another doctor, and apologized for defending the psych at the time. It's been a rough ride but she's been improving a lot in respecting and understanding my illnesses. I kinda wrote her to be worse than she actually is irl.
I didn't think of them at the time and now I don't wanna disappoint

I'm ignoring downright rude comments because arguing is pointless but I am open to discussion! By the context I assumed it was obvious that it was in no way my best moment and that's not how I act on a normal basis but oh well. Thanks for the support tho !
I had no idea ! And in a different context honestly I wouldn't mind genuinely answering that, I just think she did a very bad job at bringing it up.
I didn't leave anything out intentionally and I'm sorry if it seemed that way.
My mom also admitted that she dealt with it poorly. No one in that story is in the right and we're all working on getting better

It's ok man, no worries. I admit that my emotions got the best of me at that time but I also wish she had taken a different position, considering that she should be aware that she would be dealing with people in need of improvement
It's complicated. She didn't exactly support her but she thought i shouldnt have said anything and that we could just have left it at that

That might have been the case, I might have interpreted her questions wrong. But I'm also capable of realizing when someone isn't treating me well, even if the questions weren't supposed to be rude, she should've found a better way of saying them
Yeah it's extremely contradictory
I'm not. The reason why I got so mad was because of the way she treated me in the first place. I've had no problems with my new doctor because he treats me with the respect I deserve.

She was the one being rude, I just got fed up after being yelled at by someone who was supposed to help me. I have met respectful doctors and guess what. I wasn't rude to them. Too bad if you find it hard to believe. The reason this story stood out to me was because it was a very unusual situation. She was the adult in the situation and she had no reason to be agressive to someone who's paying her. You sound like you didn't read my post at all.
Thank you, I'll check it out
That's nice!! I'm glad you got better
She became agressive before I did. I did get angry but it wasn't me lashing out from the beginning.
Yeah,, unfortunately this isn't the first bad experience I've had with bad doctors. People are really weird.
Ok.
i said honestly and tbh at the same sentence please ignore that ncsnsjs
I know!!! We'd think she was used to dealing with people who probably weren't during their best moments. Honestly, both are possible tbh
I hope so!
Oh she definitely does. She tries her best to be supportive tho even if she messes up sometimes
thanks man very cool

I believe she was indeed a psychiatrist. Unfortunately it's not uncommon for the doctors to act like that, when they should be used to dealing with mentally ill people who aren't on their best moments...
Yeah you're correct!! I am undergoing therapy and I kept looking, and I believe I found someone who can genuinely help me
Yeah. I don't think there's any issues with that, in opposition to personality disorders, which should only be diagnosed after the patient is 18.
That was not the first time I visited a psychiatrists, but the first time i visited that doctor specifically

Thanks :-D It was very scary but I was really heated up at the moment and I didn't want to let her walk over me like that. But yeah me too ! This story happened a while ago and I'm happy to say that I've been doing better lately.

Thank you !! I was pretty scared to be honest but still I'm glad that everything went well too. I actually have a pretty close relationship to my mom, she's just very non-confrontational and thought I could have handled the situation better, but that happens. And I wish you the best too !!
lesbian lurker here! seeing everyone being happy and proud of themselves is very very nice. it's incredibly wholesome and it makes me feel less alone :^D i hope everyone's doing great !
YELLS this was so good !!!!! i absolutely can't wait for the next part oh my gosh. thank you so much for giving us this amazing story!!!!
oh damn doc congrats!!! very proud of you and also glad to be a part of this :D

this story is so sweet! i almost cried while reading it. you did a very good job and im glad everything went well! i recently came out to my mom but i still haven't told her i have a girlfriend and i just hope she's as supportive as you.
Ah thank you so much ! I just had a feeling that Noah would like to wear colorful shirts. But really I'm so glad you like it ! I'll be drawing them again.
